items.title: IFPRI Malawi maize market report: October 2026
items.summary: IFPRI reports that retail maize prices increased by an average of 7% in October, with increases across monitored markets in all regions. The report and downloadable price data should be consulted for market-level details; this summary is not a live quotation.

items.title: El Niño risk: Malawi should prepare for the 2026/27 growing season
items.summary: IFPRI highlights the risk of below-normal rainfall and prolonged dry spells, especially in southern Malawi. Its recommendations include crop diversification, drought-tolerant crops and improved soil management. Forecasts are uncertain and should be checked against current DCCMS advisories.

items.title: Weekly weather statement for 9–15 November 2026
items.summary: The Department of Climate Change and Meteorological Services publishes weekly weather statements for Malawi. Farmers should consult the original bulletin for district-specific conditions before making field decisions.
items.source: Department of Climate Change and Meteorological Services

items.title: Ministry reports on dairy commercialisation discussions
items.summary: The Ministry of Agriculture reported a meeting with the Shire Highlands Milk Producers Association in Blantyre to discuss development of the dairy sector.
